verdicts.reason: A shrinks the headline into two wide lines that are too weak for a portrait canvas, leaves a disconnected ~110px gap before the CTA and a large dead area below it, so it looks like a shrunk banner. B scales the 4-line headline up so it commands the format and keeps the CTA grouped beneath it, but the whole block sits low: about 170px of empty space at the top against about 50px under the button, which crowds the CTA toward the bottom edge.
